tour.title: Product tour
tour.subtitle: A guided walkthrough using sample data. No real emergency action is triggered.
tour.demoNotice: Sample data only. This tour never starts a real call, SMS, location share or alert, and it never changes your saved trips.
tour.resetDone: Sample trip and checklist restored to the demo starting point.
tour.sample.name: Big Almaty Lake day hike
tour.sample.notes: Meet at the trailhead; carry water.
tour.steps.problem.title: The problem
tour.steps.problem.body: Outdoor trips around Almaty can lose connectivity, and plans are often shared informally or not at all.
tour.steps.problem.scenario.connectivity: Trails around Almaty lose mobile signal in valleys and remote areas.
Without a stored plan, the group cannot check its own preparations offline.
tour.steps.problem.scenario.sharing.item: Routes end up in chat messages that nobody can act on later.
Trusted contacts often learn about a trip only when someone is already late.
tour.steps.problem.scenario.response.ite: Missing coordinates and agreed return times delay the first call for help.
Informal plans leave no checklist to verify before departure.
tour.steps.purpose.title: Purpose and audience
tour.steps.purpose.body: Dala Safe is for independent travelers and small groups who want a simple way to prepare and share a safety plan.
tour.steps.purpose.audience.solo.label: Solo traveler
tour.steps.purpose.audience.solo.item1: Prepare a route, a checklist and one message before leaving.
tour.steps.purpose.audience.solo.item2: Works entirely in the browser, with no account.
tour.steps.purpose.audience.group.label: Small group
tour.steps.purpose.audience.group.item1: Agree on departure, return time and shared responsibilities.
tour.steps.purpose.audience.group.item2: Print one safety plan everyone can follow.
Keep plan, checklist and trusted contact in one place.
Share a generated message — sending stays with you.
tour.steps.language.title: Language and accessibility
tour.steps.language.body: The interface supports Kazakh, Russian and English with keyboard navigation, visible focus and reduced motion.
tour.steps.language.item1: Three interface languages: Kazakh, Russian and English.
tour.steps.language.item2: Every action is reachable with the keyboard and shows a visible focus ring.
tour.steps.language.item3: Motion follows your reduced-motion system setting.
tour.steps.language.item4: Touch targets are at least 44 px on small screens.
tour.steps.language.previewNote: Preview only — the saved language preference is changed in Settings.
tour.steps.trip.title: Create a trip
tour.steps.trip.body: Record destination, timing, group size and notes. Data stays in this browser.
tour.steps.trip.hint: The fields below edit this tour's sample trip in memory only.
tour.steps.checklist.title: Checklist and safety plan
tour.steps.checklist.body: Complete the readiness checklist and generate a printable plan with rule-based guidance.
tour.steps.checklist.planBody: Rule-based guidance matched to the sample answers. Open guidance in the real trip view works the same way.
tour.steps.checklist.noGuidance: No rule matches the current answers yet.
tour.steps.share.title: Trusted contact and sharing
tour.steps.share.body: Generate a message, then copy or share it yourself. Generating is not sending.
tour.steps.reminder.title: Return reminder
tour.steps.reminder.body: Download an .ics file with two alarms. Client behaviour varies, so it is not a guarantee.
tour.reminder.ready: Calendar file generated on this device.
tour.steps.emergency.title: Emergency screen
tour.steps.emergency.body: Call official numbers, obtain coordinates if permitted, and use the dispatcher phrasebook.
tour.steps.emergency.geoNote: Coordinates are requested only when you tap the button on the emergency screen. This tour never requests your location.
tour.steps.offline.title: Offline limits
tour.steps.offline.body: Essential guidance is available offline after the first load. Live hazard data is never cached as current.
tour.steps.offline.works.item1: Stored trips, checklists and safety plans.
tour.steps.offline.needs.item1: Live weather and hazard data are never cached as current.
tour.steps.future.title: Regional information and future capabilities
tour.steps.future.body: Sample demonstrations show weather, group coordination, satellite and integration concepts — all clearly labelled.
tour.steps.future.item.weather.title: Weather and hazard outlook
tour.steps.future.item.weather.body: A demonstration of how a forecast could attach to a trip, using clearly labelled sample data.
tour.steps.future.item.coordination.body: Concept for shared check-ins and status inside one trip.
tour.steps.future.item.satellite.title: Satellite and messaging
tour.steps.future.item.satellite.body: Concept only — it needs hardware and provider contracts.
tour.steps.future.item.integrations.body: Registration and monitoring would require real services and independent review.
tour.steps.roadmap.title: Roadmap and expected impact
tour.steps.roadmap.body: The MVP focuses on a reliable local workflow. Official integrations and monitoring require real services and review.
tour.steps.roadmap.item.1.title: Local workflow — available now
tour.steps.roadmap.item.1.body: Trip, checklist, safety plan, message, reminder and emergency guidance that all run in the browser.
tour.steps.roadmap.item.2.title: Verified content — next
tour.steps.roadmap.item.2.body: Source review dates and human-checked translations for safety content.
tour.steps.roadmap.item.3.title: Connected services — later
tour.steps.roadmap.item.3.body: Weather, monitoring and official integrations only once real services exist.
tour.steps.roadmap.impact1: Fewer trips start without a shared plan or an agreed return time.
tour.steps.roadmap.impact2: Faster, better-informed first calls for help.
